summary: IDS feed c073_broker is severely degraded: VF-1 port 5 is discarding 62.26% of packets due to sustained 10 Gbps congestion, so IDS misses majority of traffic and detection coverage is critically reduced.

findings.root_cause: Egress port VF-1:5 to IDS is persistently oversubscribed - averaging 100% of 10 Gbps with bursts higher - causing output queue tail drops. 123,727,500 packets discarded (62.26% loss) exceeds 0.1% threshold. Tool port is 1 Gbps per profile, so 10 Gbps aggregate cannot be delivered to single IDS port.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS loses ~62% of packets including flows and payload needed for signature matching. Both-directions visibility and full-payload inspection required by IDS fails - attacks, C2, and exploits in dropped packets will be missed, state tracking breaks, and alerts are unreliable.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute 10G+ aggregate across multiple IDS ports/instances with 5-tuple hashing to keep flows intact, or upgrade IDS capacity/filter feed to fit 1G tool. Eliminates single-port congestion and restores complete traffic to IDS for detection.
